title: עוגיות שושנה
notes: Large shaky handwriting on a square card. The front carries a printed 'רשות הדואר - דואר קדימה' logo at the bottom. The back (23) is grouped as the continuation because of the handwriting and the ingredients ending mid-list; this grouping is probable but not certain.

The top line of the front holds two words: a long first word (title?) and a shorter second word (a name?). Gemini read them as 'סוהרורים שושנה' (title + source); the ink does not let me confirm either, so title and source are left open.

Gemini's transcription adds items that are not visible on the card and were ignored: 'חבילות', baking powder, wine, vanilla sugar quantities, a jam/lemon/chocolate filling, cutting into triangles and rolling 'like rugelach'.
Owner's title: 'עוגיות שושנה'. Title reviewed by the owner (PR review, 2026-10-06); the rest of the transcription has NOT been proofread yet.
incidental_text: Printed logo: רשות הדואר - דואר קדימה

uncertainties.best_guess: Gemini: סוהרורים (with the source 'שושנה' on the same line)
uncertainties.reason: The top line of the front is very irregular; the first word has about 7-8 letters and ends in ים, but I cannot confirm Gemini's spelling or that it is a title.
The left word of the top line could be a person's name; not confirmable from the ink.
The digit looks like a 3 (open to the left, unlike the 2s on the card); no unit is written.
The word does not obviously match Gemini's reading; letters before 'פירן' are unclear.
Word before 'סוכר' and the end of 'פסטי...' after '=' are unreadable.
Last ingredient overlaps the printed logo and is very irregular; Gemini cut it at '2 כוסות...'.
Only 'מי', 'באמת', 'להוסיף', 'מעט קינמון' and a few letters are readable; Gemini's fuller method is not visible on the card.
The two scans are probably one recipe (same pen, same card type), but no title or number confirms it.
